user.title: Configure V15 Lastmanagement
user.description: Choose a grid power sensor and approved load switches. Automatic restoration only switches loads back on if V15 itself switched them off earlier in the same run. **Live load control is disabled after every restart.**

data.load_switches: Switches eligible for load shedding (in priority order)
data.auto_restore: Automatically switch previously shed loads back on

data_description.grid_sensor: Current grid power sensor, in W or kW. Positive values should normally indicate grid import.
data_description.limit_kw: Target maximum average grid import during each fixed 15-minute interval starting at :00, :15, :30 or :45.
data_description.reserve_kw: Safety headroom below the threshold. For example, 5.0 kW limit minus 0.5 kW reserve gives a 4.5 kW target.
data_description.reverse_sign: Enable only if your sensor reports grid import as a negative value.
data_description.stale_seconds: Older measurements are treated as invalid. V15 does not switch any loads when measurements are invalid.
data_description.load_switches: Select only explicitly approved, non-critical switches. The order determines which load is shed first.
data_description.auto_restore: Only loads that V15 itself switched off in this run can be restored after sufficient power headroom. Live control must also be enabled separately.
data_description.restore_stable_seconds: Available headroom must remain sufficient for this long before restoration is permitted.
data_description.restore_min_off_seconds: A load shed by V15 remains off for at least this period, even if headroom becomes available sooner.
data_description.restore_margin_watts: Extra headroom, in watts, required in addition to the estimated load power when switching it on.
data_description.evcc_configured: Adds a separate setup step for evcc entities. Charging is never controlled until the separate V15 evcc charging control switch is explicitly enabled. Disable other automations controlling the evcc maximum current beforehand.

restore.title: Estimated maximum power per load (W)
restore.description:
**Why are these values needed?** Before switching a load back on, V15 checks whether its expected power **plus an additional safety margin** fits into the available power budget.

**Enter a conservative maximum power estimate in watts for each switch**, preferably including any startup surge. Do not enter average consumption or **kW**. Example: Enter `600` for a load that can draw up to 600 W. Underestimating the power can cause a threshold exceedance.

**Selected switches (same order as the input fields):**
{switches}

Only loads previously switched off by V15 are restored automatically. Restarting or changing settings does not restore earlier loads.

evcc.title: Configure evcc charging point
evcc.description:
**Optional: uses evcc entities already available in Home Assistant.** V15 may cap the maximum current. Only if pausing is explicitly allowed may it switch the loadpoint mode from `smart` to `off` and back to `smart`. It never selects `now`.

**The V15 evcc controller is disabled on every Home Assistant restart.** Charging limits or pauses may remain in evcc after restart and may need manual intervention. evcc still owns solar surplus, tariff and charging-plan logic.

data.evcc_fixed_phases: Phase count if no sensor is selected (1 or 3)
data.evcc_allow_pause: Allow automatic pause when budget is insufficient

data_description.evcc_current_entity: Choose e.g. select.evcc_go_e_wallbox_max_current. Only supported select choices or a number entity will be used.
data_description.evcc_mode_entity: Choose e.g. select.evcc_go_e_wallbox_mode. The mode must be smart before control can be activated. now/off are not taken over.
data_description.evcc_charge_power_entity: Measured charging power in W or kW, e.g. sensor.evcc_go_e_wallbox_charge_power.
data_description.evcc_phases_entity: Sensor returning 1 or 3. Unknown phase counts block control. The last known phase count can be used conservatively during a V15-owned pause.
data_description.evcc_fixed_phases: Used if no phase sensor is chosen. Never enter 1 for a charger capable of charging on 3 phases.
data_description.evcc_min_current_a: Usually 6 A per IEC 61851. Below minimum, V15 can only pause if this is explicitly allowed.
data_description.evcc_max_current_a: Amperes. V15 never raises the cap above the value present when control is enabled.
data_description.evcc_voltage: Usually 230 V. Calculations are estimates, not billing-grade measurements.
data_description.evcc_margin_w: Extra reserve for evcc control, in addition to the V15 safety reserve.
data_description.evcc_stable_seconds: Increases and resuming a V15-owned pause require stable power headroom.
data_description.evcc_step_seconds: At least 30 seconds. Wait for entity state confirmation after each command.
data_description.evcc_allow_pause: V15 may change smart to off if even minimum charging power exceeds budget. Only owned pauses may be resumed. The mode can remain off after restart/disable.

error.reserve_too_high: The safety reserve must be lower than the threshold.
error.restore_requires_loads: Select at least one load switch to enable automatic restoration.
error.evcc_current_limits: Minimum charging current must not exceed the maximum.
error.evcc_separate_entities: Charging mode and maximum current must be different entities.
